home.title: Football predictions built on probabilities, not hunches
paragraphs: IASHARK's statistical model estimates each team's chances from match data: results, goals, form and home and away performances. For every Premier League, Champions League and European fixture we cover, it estimates the probability of each result, the number of goals and both teams to score. Bookmaker odds, with the margin removed, are used to compare against those estimates and to choose among the markets actually on offer.

These are statistical estimates: football is uncertain, no outcome is guaranteed and IASHARK is not a bookmaker. Data coverage varies by league, so every analysis shows its data-quality rating. 18+ only.
